notes: The supplied descriptions and original/replication page locators are identical across assigned IDs (apart from requested replication metric); they do not distinguish manipulation check, focal cheating effect, or belief–cheating association. No target was assigned from input order. Extracted the primary experimental cheating contrast consistently for all IDs as a transparent candidate; target_match remains null because the intended test is not uniquely established. The cached original is a title-verified author manuscript with pagination different from the supplied p. 3 locator: Experiment 1 results are on manuscript p. 6. It also prints a belief–cheating correlation r(30)=-.53 and a belief predictor ANCOVA F(1,27)=7.81, p<.01. Replication p. 5 also contains a distinct manipulation-check d=0.064, p=.46; its exploratory direct belief–cheating association is on p. 8, b=−0.16, p=.54. These were not substituted for the focal test. Authors report no supporting evidence and characterize the causal test as unfit; success vocabulary records their explicit limitation. All statistics retained as printed; no conversion performed.
